title: elymus retusus
intro: Elymus retusus, commonly known as bent grass or bent, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with its reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Elymus retusus include wound healing, anti-oxidative stress, and immune system modulation, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Elymus retusus for medicinal purposes.
